relations.text: IonQ Forte Enterpriseが、AWSの量子コンピューティング・サービスAmazon Braket経由で世界の顧客に提供される(2025年4月1日、IonQ発表)
relations.text_en: IonQ Forte Enterprise is available to customers globally through Amazon Braket, the AWS managed quantum computing service (April 1, 2025, IonQ release)

source.label: IonQ の発表
source.quote: IonQ Forte Enterprise, IonQ’s recently commissioned quantum computer is now officially available to customers globally through Amazon Braket, a managed quantum computing service from Amazon Web Services (AWS)
source.note_en: AWS is a unit of Amazon.com.

relations.text: IonQが年次報告で、量子コンピューターの現在の競合の1社としてAmazonを挙げている(2025年度、10-K)
relations.text_en: IonQ’s FY2025 10-K lists Amazon among its current competitors in quantum computing

source.label: IonQ 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: large, well-established technology companies that generally compete in all of our markets, including Amazon, Google, IBM, Intel and Microsoft

relations.text: IonQの量子コンピューターをMicrosoftのクラウド基盤Azure Quantumで提供(2025年度、10-K)
relations.text_en: IonQ makes its quantum computers available through Microsoft’s Azure Quantum cloud platform (FY2025 10-K)

source.label: IonQ 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: We currently make access to our quantum computers available through three major cloud platforms, Amazon Web Services’, or AWS’s, Braket, Microsoft’s Azure Quantum and Google’s Cloud Marketplace

relations.text_en: IonQ makes its quantum computers available through the Google Cloud Marketplace (FY2025 10-K)

source.label: IonQ 10-K(2025年度)

relations.text: 日本でIonQの量子コンピューターを販売する旗艦的な販売代理店契約を豊田通商と締結(2025年4月23日、IonQ発表)
relations.text_en: Signed a flagship distributor partnership with Toyota Tsusho to sell IonQ quantum computing in Japan (April 23, 2025, IonQ release)

source.label: IonQ の発表
source.quote: today announced a pivotal flagship distributor partnership with Toyota Tsusho Corporation (Toyota Tsusho) to accelerate quantum computing in Japan

relations.text: GDIT(General Dynamicsの事業部門)と、政府・防衛向けの量子ソリューションを共同開発・販売する提携(2025年1月22日、IonQ発表)
relations.text_en: IonQ and General Dynamics Information Technology (GDIT) partnered to co-develop and market quantum solutions for government and defense (January 22, 2025, IonQ release)

source.label: IonQ の発表
source.quote: General Dynamics Information Technology (GDIT), a business unit of General Dynamics, announced a partnership to bring the power of quantum computing to government and defense sectors
source.note: 相手はGeneral Dynamicsの事業部門のGDITです。
source.note_en: The partner is GDIT, a business unit of General Dynamics.

relations.text: NVIDIAのAccelerated Quantum Research Centerで、初のオンプレミス量子コンピューターとして導入。NVQLink経由でNVIDIA GB200 NVL72と接続(2026年9月23日、IonQ発表)
relations.text_en: IonQ will be the first on-premise quantum computing deployment at NVIDIA’s Accelerated Quantum Research Center, linked to NVIDIA GB200 NVL72 via NVQLink (September 23, 2026, IonQ release)

source.label: IonQ の発表
source.quote: IonQ (NYSE: IONQ) announced that it will be the first on-premise quantum computing deployment at the NVIDIA Accelerated Quantum Research Center (NVAQC)

relations.text: IonQ・AstraZeneca・AWS・NVIDIAが、量子で加速した計算化学の共同研究を実施し20倍の高速化を確認(2025年6月9日、IonQ発表)
relations.text_en: IonQ, AstraZeneca, AWS and NVIDIA ran a joint quantum-accelerated computational chemistry research program with a 20x speedup (June 9, 2025, IonQ release)

source.label: IonQ の発表
source.quote: announced results of a collaborative research program between IonQ, AstraZeneca, Amazon Web Services (AWS), and NVIDIA

relations.text: Synopsysとの共同研究で、量子アルゴリズムが工学シミュレーションを最大14.6%高速化することを示した(2026年9月17日、IonQ発表)
relations.text_en: IonQ detailed joint research with Synopsys showing quantum algorithms accelerating engineering simulation workloads by up to 14.6% (September 17, 2026, IonQ release)

source.label: IonQ の発表
source.quote: today detailed research conducted with Synopsys

relations.text: 衛星通信向けの安全な量子ネットワークを探るため、Intellianと覚書(MoU)を締結(2025年4月16日、IonQ発表)
relations.text_en: Signed an MoU with Intellian to explore secure quantum networking for satellite communications (April 16, 2025, IonQ release)

source.label: IonQ の発表
source.quote: announced that it has signed a memorandum of understanding (MoU) with Intellian Technologies, Inc.
source.note: 検討段階の覚書で、正式な商取引の契約は書かれていません。
source.note_en: An MoU to explore; no definitive commercial agreement is stated.

relations.text: ID Quantiqueの買収とあわせ、SK Telecomと量子分野の戦略的提携に入る見込みと発表(2025年2月26日、IonQ発表)
relations.text_en: Expected to enter a quantum-focused strategic partnership with SK Telecom alongside the ID Quantique acquisition (February 26, 2025, IonQ release)

source.label: IonQ の発表
source.quote: IonQ expects to enter into a strategic partnership focused on quantum with SK Telecom, the largest wireless telecommunications operator in South Korea
source.note: 2025年2月の発表時点では予定・覚書の段階でした。
source.note_en: Planned or MoU stage as of the February 2025 announcement.

relations.text: Samsung Electronicsは、IonQの上場前の出資者の1社(2025年4月16日、IonQ発表)
relations.text_en: Samsung Electronics was a pre-IPO investor in IonQ (April 16, 2025, IonQ release)

source.label: IonQ の発表
source.quote: Key milestones include investments from Korean global technology leaders Samsung Electronics and Hyundai Motor Company prior to IonQ’s 2021 IPO
source.note: 出資は2021年の上場前で、現在の保有は書かれていません。
source.note_en: The investment predates IonQ’s 2021 IPO; the current holding is not stated.

relations.text: Hyundai Motorは上場前にIonQへ出資し、電池や自動運転の量子プロジェクトで協業(2025年4月16日、IonQ発表)
relations.text_en: Hyundai Motor invested in IonQ pre-IPO and has collaborated on quantum projects for batteries and autonomous vehicles (April 16, 2025, IonQ release)

source.label: IonQ の発表
source.quote: IonQ has since collaborated with Hyundai on multiple quantum projects aimed at advancing next-generation batteries and autonomous vehicle technologies
source.note: 出資は2021年の上場前で、協業の時期は書かれていません。
source.note_en: The investment predates the 2021 IPO; collaboration dates are not specified.

relations.text: 2022年にAirbusと、貨物の積載・配分の量子アルゴリズム開発で提携(2025年3月14日、IonQ発表)
relations.text_en: IonQ and Airbus partnered in 2022 on a project to develop quantum algorithms for cargo loading and distribution (March 14, 2025, IonQ release)

source.label: IonQ の発表
source.quote: In 2022, IonQ and Airbus partnered on a project to develop smarter algorithms based on quantum computers to achieve cost savings due to more efficient cargo loading and distribution
source.note: プロジェクトは2022年のもので、2025年の発表で振り返って触れています。
source.note_en: The project dates from 2022 and is cited retrospectively in a 2025 release.
